component.name: Eyes Saver
component.summary: Tint every display to cut glare and blue light

description.p: Eyes Saver lays a warm, click-through color tint over each of your displays. Every display can have its own color and strength, and displays you plug in or out are picked up automatically, with their settings remembered.

ul.li: Presets from soft warm yellow to deep red, or any color you pick
Per-display or all-at-once settings, with a live map of your display layout
Works with a compositor (overlay) or without one (display gamma)

description.p: First Linux release: X11 and XWayland, Flatpak and .deb packages.
